caption:
Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Seven (people) will be shaded by Allah by His Shade on the Day of Resurrection when there will be no shade except His Shade. (They will be), a just ruler, a young man who has been brought up in the worship of Allah, a man who remembers Allah in seclusion and his eyes are then flooded with tears, a man whose heart is attached to mosques (offers his compulsory congregational prayers in the mosque), two men who love each other for Allah's Sake, a man who is called by a charming lady of noble birth to commit illegal sexual intercourse with her, and he says, 'I am afraid of Allah,' and (finally), a man who gives in charity so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right hand has given."

Sahih al-Bukhari 6806. Part 32 of 52 in our series on everything the Quran and the Prophet's hadith say about zina. Swipe for the Arabic, English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

#Hadith #Chastity #IslamicReminder #Deen #Guidance

sourcing.primary_text: Sahih al-Bukhari 6806 (hadith-api numbering; Book 86, Hadith 35). Selected from a full-text scan of all hadith-api English editions (Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Nasa'i, Ibn Majah, Malik, Nawawi, Dehlawi) for zina / adultery / fornication / illegal sexual intercourse / prostitution; one representative narration per distinct statement of the Prophet.
sourcing.arabic_and_english: Live-fetched twice on 2026-10-17 from cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/fawazahmed0/hadith-api@1/editions/ara-bukhari and eng-bukhari, HTTP 200, the two fetches diffed identical. Slides written programmatically from the API text.
sourcing.arabic_extraction: Arabic slide shows the Prophet's words only (text between the quotation marks, or a marked sub-range where the API Arabic has no quotes); chain of narrators omitted from the slide, not altered. Invisible directional marks and stray quote characters removed.
sourcing.english_note: English trimmed only at the edges where noted (chain/narrator commentary), punctuation restored at the end only. sourcing.chinese_korean_japanese_malay_thai_spani: hadith-api has no Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai or Spanish edition. These six slides are Claude's own translation from the verified Arabic and English, labelled on-slide as such; no scholar is named.
